answers.basis: An abstract of no more than 250 words is required. The abstract must not include references.
A list of up to five keywords should be provided below the abstract.

answers.answer: 50文字以内（空白含む）。第3ページから必要。
answers.basis: At the header on each odd page from page 3, a Running Title not exceeding 50 characters including spaces is required

answers.answer: 参考文献番号は括弧内に書き、句読点の前。例: [1,3,5-8]
answers.basis: When cited in the text, reference numbers must be put in brackets in the form [1,3,5-8] before a ‘period’ or a ‘comma’.
For more than six authors, list the first six authors followed by “et al.”

answers.answer: 図: TIFF, PNG, JPEG, PDF形式で300dpi。グラフィカルアブストラクト: PNG, JPEG, GIF形式で300dpi。
answers.basis: Electronic files of photographs and illustrations should be at 300 dpi resolution... We accept figure files in TIFF, PNG, JPEG or PDF formats. The format of the graphical abstract should be PNG, JPEG or GIF, and the resolution should be 300 dpi.

answers.answer: 1. 表は本文中で引用する必要がある。2. 表番号はアラビア数字で連続して付与。3. 表の下に表脚を付与。
answers.basis: All tables must be cited in the text. Number the tables consecutively with Arabic numerals... Supply a short explanatory title above the body of the table, and table footnotes lettered a, b, c, and so forth, below the body of the table.

answers.answer: 20MB。超える場合はJ-STAGE Dataにアップロード。
answers.basis: The size of each file that is uploaded using the online submission system... should be no more than 20 MB. When the supplementary materials are larger than 20 MB, please upload them to another relating BPPB data repository, J-STAGE Data.
Titles and abstracts of manuscripts may not contain the positive words: “New”, “Novel”, “First”, “Unprecedented”, or other similar descriptive words.

answers.answer: 規定に記載がありません
